structural_change: Regional synchronous reset successor: eight arithmetic roots + four insertion roots have ot_sync_rst_relay SYNC2 on command root/TREE1 per destination root (entirely synchronous including assertion; no async-clear cells); pin command and output roots have local relays, all arithmetic/insert consumers synchronous under OT_SU_SYNC_RST. Port reset drives only relay input cells; steady operation stage counts unchanged. Reset release3 edges, first accepted command edge4 (vs PIN_RST1 edge1), explicit startup assertions and actual reset-bypass mutant. New leaf (first route): KIND1 HEAVY lane in the CLOSED KIND0 r2 leaf form (pin-registered lane_pinreg, PIN_RST=1, LAT4/LEAF1); outline 166.32 x 330.48 = the d4c pgslice row plan (KIND1 synth 22,528 um2 at the measured kind0 0.416 synth:outline ratio). Pins <= 6/um (new-tile guidance): pin_min_tracks 4 (0.192 um, 5.2/um); the 840-bit ld_c moves from N to the 330-um W face (N keeps the 12 clock entries; W 1,032 / S 562 / E 315 bits). Correction after pre-floorplan OT_MULTI_ROOT refusal: declare all eight arithmetic stage roots and four insertion-line roots, including SFU stage4 and insert[3:0], rather than inheriting KIND0 unused-clock data inputs. No cycle, area, clock period or RTL change.
